Name: Tablets of Ruin
Effect: Reduce by 2 the Strength of everyone in the field, except this Pokémon. This Pokémon in immune to the effects of the Abilities: Beads of Ruin, Sword of Ruin, Tablets of Ruin, and Vessel of Ruin. Unique Ability.
Description: There is a cursed artifact on this Pokémon. A putrid moldy sickness consumes everyone's body. This Pokémon loves to enfeeble and weaken others.
